name: Up to Snuff
summary: In Booty Bay, the pirate Deeg likes a bottle of grog and fine snuff whenever in port, but the town's herbalist has sold out. The herbalist says Bloodsail Raiders hijacked the shipment, and Deeg wants fifteen shares of snuff brought to him.

sections.title: Vices Ashore
sections.body: Deeg admits the sea life may not be the good life, yet it is the only one Deeg has. In port, Deeg looks for grog and good-quality snuff: bad habits, but a pirate needs his vices. Deeg was crushed to learn that the herbalist in Booty Bay has none left. The herbalist claims Bloodsail Raiders hijacked the shipment. Deeg figures a fearless adventurer could talk the raiders into sharing, and wants fifteen shares of snuff.

sections.title: Deeg's Thanks
sections.body: Deeg is delighted with the snuff, glad it arrived just before time to ship out, and thanks you warmly as an old friend.

faq.answer: Deeg is a pirate in Booty Bay who looks for grog and fine snuff whenever in port.

faq.q: Why is the herbalist out of snuff?
faq.answer: According to the herbalist, the shipment of snuff was hijacked by the Bloodsail Raiders.
According to the herbalist, Bloodsail Raiders hijacked the shipment, and Deeg hopes they can be talked into sharing it.

faq.q: How much snuff does Deeg want?
faq.answer: Fifteen shares of snuff, brought to Deeg in Booty Bay.
